content.title: 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of acute coronary syndromes - Reviewers
content.declaration_note: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during development period up to and including 2022).
content.additional_interests_summary: The expert reports research and educational grants to their institution from multiple industry sponsors and serves/served in unpaid advisory or steering/executive roles for several trials funded by industry. The expert has not received personal payments by pharmaceutical companies or device manufacturers for certain activities and is a member of multiple committees and advisory groups (specific personal names have been redacted).
year_2022_payments: Payment from healthcare industry to department/institution for personal services (speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc.)
